JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: Software Engineer
Company: TechCore Solutions
Location: Hyderabad, India
Employment Type: Full-time
JOB SUMMARY
We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and maintain
scalable software applications. The candidate will work closely with
software engineers, product managers, and other technical teams.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
2-5 years of professional software development experience.
REQUIRED SKILLS
- Java
- Python
- Object-Oriented Programming
- Data Structures
- Algorithms
- SQL
- REST APIs
- Spring Boot
- Git
PREFERRED SKILLS
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- Microservices
- AWS
- PostgreSQL
- Unit Testing
- CI/CD
EDUCATION
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information
Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Design and develop software applications.
- Write clean and maintainable code.
- Develop REST APIs.
- Design and optimize database queries.
- Perform unit testing.
- Debug and resolve software issues.
- Participate in code reviews.
- Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams.
- Follow Agile software development practices.
CERTIFICATIONS
Cloud computing or software development certifications are preferred.
